decisions.reason: Requiring all three clips to come from one video does not change the independent completeness or teaching-value criteria.
The batch source constraint does not change the clean, professional, effects, or transition standards.
Selecting all clips from one source video narrows source selection but does not alter the requirement to choose strong moments.
The source-video constraint has no effect on the required use of color in captions or letters.
The requirement that all trial clips come from one video does not change the 30-to-90-second duration range.
The qualification process still requires three qualifying clips; their common source is independently represented by the clip-source Requirement.
The batch source constraint does not change the deferred Lead Clipper pathway, training, or responsibilities.
Selecting all clips from one video does not change where or how clips are submitted for review.
The source constraint applies to the three trial clips and leaves the monthly quota of 125 approved clips unchanged.
